heroHeadline: Ukraine Strikes Russian Shadow Tankers Off Novorossiysk; Russia's 268-Drone Attack Kills 4
heroSubtitle: Ukraine's drone forces struck Russian shadow fleet oil tankers and a cruise missile carrier near Novorossiysk in a 334-drone barrage on May 3, dealing a blow to Russia's sanction-evading energy exports. Russia launched 268 drones plus an Iskander-M ballistic missile overnight May 2-3, killing 4 civilians in Chornomorsk, Dnipro, and Kherson despite 249 interceptions. Ukraine's ongoing refinery campaign — including a 4th strike on the Tuapse refinery May 1 — has driven Russia's processing capacity to a 16-year low of 4.69 million barrels per day, costing Russia $7B+ in 2026.
